tagline: CVR Energy is a diversified holding company engaged in petroleum refining and marketing, renewable fuels production, and nitrogen fertilizer manufacturing.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Petroleum segment is the primary revenue driver for CVR Energy, reflecting its core operations in refining and marketing transportation fuels (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel).

kpis.name: Petroleum Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from refining and marketing transportation fuels.
kpis.description: This segment includes refining and marketing of fuels such as gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel, as well as crude oil gathering and logistics activities.

kpis.name: Renewables Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue derived from refining renewable feedstocks into renewable diesel.
kpis.description: This segment involves refining renewable feedstocks such as soybean oil and corn oil into renewable diesel.
kpis.signal: Transitional business activity impacted by economic conditions and regulations

kpis.name: Nitrogen Fertilizer Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the production and distribution of nitrogen fertilizers.
kpis.description: This segment covers the production of ammonia and urea ammonium nitrate (UAN) for the agricultural industry, operated by CVR Partners.
kpis.signal: Contributes to the company's revenue diversification

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Measures the direct profitability of production and sales activities.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in the company's long-term assets.
kpis.description: Represents spending to acquire or upgrade physical assets.
kpis.signal: Indicates investments in capacity and maintenance

kpis.name: Refining Margin Volatility
kpis.explanation: Risk related to fluctuations in margins between crude oil prices and refined product prices.
kpis.description: Financial results in the Petroleum segment are significantly influenced by the margin between refined product prices and crude oil and feedstock costs.

kpis.name: RFS Small Refinery Exemptions
kpis.explanation: Impact of EPA regulatory decisions regarding Renewable Fuel Standard exemptions.
kpis.description: In August 2025, the EPA granted Wynnewood Refining Company waivers for compliance periods 2017-2024, reducing RFS obligations by over 424 million RINs, representing approximately $488 million.
kpis.signal: Regulatory decisions directly affect RFS obligations and financial impact

kpis.name: RFS Small Refinery Exemptions
kpis.explanation: Impact of EPA regulatory decisions regarding Renewable Fuel Standard exemptions.
kpis.description: In August 2025, the EPA granted Wynnewood Refining Company waivers for compliance periods 2017-2024, reducing RFS obligations by over 424 million RINs, representing approximately $488 million.
kpis.signal: Regulatory decisions directly affect RFS obligations and financial impact

risks.title: Refining Margin Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly states that refining margins are historically volatile and vary by region. Petroleum segment results primarily depend on the margin between refined product prices and crude oil costs. This is mentioned repeatedly in the Risk Factors and MD&A sections.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive refining sector. Petroleum product prices are influenced by operating levels of other refineries and regional and global competition.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events, OPEC+ decisions, and international conflicts affect crude oil and refined product prices, directly impacting margins and financial results.

risks.title: Regulatory Change Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in trade policies, environmental regulations, and Renewable Fuel Standards (RFS) can have a significant impact. The EPA's August 2025 decision on RFS exemptions demonstrates the critical importance of this factor.

risks.title: Geographic Concentration of Operations
risks.score_rationale: Refining operations are concentrated at the Wynnewood (Oklahoma) and Coffeyville (Kansas) refineries, making the company vulnerable to regional events, logistical constraints, and supply disruptions.

risks.title: Raw Material Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Nitrogen fertilizer and renewable feedstock prices are volatile and depend on global supply and demand factors, affecting the profitability of the Renewables and Nitrogen segments.

risks.title: Operational and Execution Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on uninterrupted supply of crude oil and renewable feedstocks. Supply interruptions, logistical constraints, and refining yields affect operational capacity.

ai_positioning.summary: CVR Energy does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, business segments, refining operations, and regulatory issues.
